name: Ak 47
operating_principle: The AK-47/AKM operates on a gas-operated mechanism, where propellant gases from the fired cartridge are diverted through the gas port into the gas tube, driving the gas piston backward and cycling the bolt carrier group.

components.description: The barrel group consists of the barrel, front sight block, and gas port.
The gas system includes the gas tube, gas piston, and gas block.
The bolt and bolt carrier group consists of the bolt, bolt carrier, and piston.
The receiver and dust cover form the main structural body of the rifle.
The fire control group includes the trigger, hammer, sear, and selector.
The feed system consists of the magazine and magazine catch.
The furniture includes the stock, grip, and handguard.
The sights include the front sight and rear sight.
